warlock_eldritch_summoning.name: Eldritch Summoning
warlock_eldritch_summoning.note1: Minor imps do not explode if killed by enemy heroes.
warlock_eldritch_summoning.description: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.
warlock_eldritch_summoning.shard_description: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.

warlock_fatal_bonds.name: Fatal Bonds
warlock_fatal_bonds.description: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
warlock_fatal_bonds.lore: An ancient incantation that links the vital energies of multiple lifeforms into one collective body.
warlock_fatal_bonds.note0: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
warlock_fatal_bonds.note1: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

warlock_shadow_word.name: Shadow Word
warlock_shadow_word.description: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.
warlock_shadow_word.scepter_description: Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to %additional_targets% additional units in a %cast_aoe% radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %secondary_reduction%%%.
warlock_shadow_word.lore: Demnok's arcane arts have a myriad of uses, allowing them to be powerful friendly enchantments or damaging curses.

warlock_upheaval.name: Upheaval
warlock_upheaval.description: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Enemies are slowed for %duration% second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
warlock_upheaval.lore: Demnok manipulates space-time, impairing entire armies.
warlock_upheaval.note0: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.
warlock_upheaval.shard_description: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every %imps_interval% seconds that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.

warlock_rain_of_chaos.name: Chaotic Offering
warlock_rain_of_chaos.description: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds. The Golem lives %golem_duration% seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
warlock_rain_of_chaos.facet_warlock_golem: Chaotic Offering Golems deal more burn damage based on Warlock's health and mana regeneration.
warlock_rain_of_chaos.lore: Demnok unleashes the captive spirit in his Dreadwood staff, causing destruction in enemy ranks.
warlock_rain_of_chaos.note0: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
